prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game HUD health-bar FRAME on genuinely transparent alpha, for an existing refined Chinese mythology side-view action RPG. Primary request: a long, wide, substantial BOSS HEALTH BAR surround with an empty see-through horizontal central aperture. One single cohesive horizontal ornament, no separate UI pieces, no mockup and no scene. Long thin overall proportions about 12:1: a bronze and antique pale-gold lacquered frame, elegant sculpted cloud-scroll end caps, restrained engraved flame motifs, crisp dimensional painterly pixel-cluster craftsmanship. The CENTRAL 82 PERCENT of the bar is perfectly straight and uncluttered, top and bottom rails separated by a tall clear empty slot reserved for a red moving health fill supplied by the game. End caps a little taller than the rails, dignified powerful Chinese fantasy style, avoid huge dragon faces or towering ornaments that cover gameplay. At game scale the complete asset will be roughly 700-1000px wide and 60-75px high, so make the opening visibly THICK and usable rather than a hairline. Both the outer canvas around the frame AND the entire inner aperture MUST be alpha-zero transparent, NOT black-filled, no red fill, no solid panel, no background texture inside the opening. No bar divisions, no tick marks, no health numbers, no boss name, NO TEXT, no labels, no icons floating above. Whole frame visible with large transparent canvas padding left/right/top/bottom, no clipping. Muted bronze, pale gold edge glints, dark carved recesses; refined rich detail but readable silhouette. No scenery, no characters, no rectangular background, no sheet grid, no screenshot composition, no glow haze, no drop shadow rectangle, no baked checkerboard. Genuine transparency is essential because a responsive HTML health fill will sit behind the opening.
